workflow.text: Review the mirror/chair arrangement andlighting reference. Declare your actual surface,view andconditions separately;this application does not require the historical booth or hardware.
Optionally record an intention or personal context. There is no pressure to experience imagery andno need to choose oridentify a deceased person.
If you choose,gaze into the mirror while relaxed. This subset excludes waiting for an apparition;blink normally,avoid strain andskip orstop whenever you wish.
Finish when you choose;no historical duration or watch restriction is imposed. You may discontinue without imagery.
Record your own experience,or no imagery. Writing is an editorial adaptation of the documented discussion,not a claim that this app provides facilitated processing.
Keep personal associations separate from raw notes;review them without assigning contact,diagnosis or universal meaning.

adaptation: A source-bounded relaxed mirror-gazing/journaling subset,not complete Moody psychomanteum induction. Source setup/context remain references;all-day walk/lunch,recliner/bone-conduction induction,required blackout/watch removal andexpectation of an apparition are not implemented. Blinking/avoid-strain/discontinue policy andwritten journal are explicit editorial qualifications.
